title: G3b competence plan frozen and independently reviewed
summary: Three execution paths were completed and compared. Direct single-session five-million-choice Kaggle training and direct Modal training were rejected; staged private Kaggle T4 x2 with exact one-million-choice resumable chunks was selected. The canonical plan binds three derived seeds, a separate two-layout canary, exact assets and four rule anchors, fixed PPO configurations, 6,000-game evaluation cycles, checkpoint/resume requirements and zero-tolerance stops. Twenty-seven edge-case tests, 201 G3 tests, 404 total Python tests and Ruff passed before the source commit; independent review passed. G3b remains blocked because the CABT actor/learner bridge is not implemented. No G3b launch is authorized.
